citation:
New England Biolabs. "PCR Using Q5 High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix (NEB #M0492)."
https://www.neb.com/en-us/protocols/2012/12/07/protocol-for-q5-high-fidelity-2x-master-mix-m0492
Accessed 6 September 2026. No DOI.

NEB returns 403 to scripted requests, so the source was read through a browser
and the text saved by hand into source.md. source.md is the page as it reads;
parsed.yaml is an authored reduction of it, and the difference between the two is
described in labels.yaml.

Used here for research and evaluation. The protocol text belongs to NEB; nothing
in this repository redistributes it as a product.
speaker: luna
label: evidence

instructions: Greet them. Say this is PCR Using Q5 High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix (NEB #M0492) - 50 µl Reaction, that it has 17 steps, and that they should say start when they are ready. Two sentences at most. Do not read the first step.

text: Start the procedure.
Hi there! This is spell(PCR) Using Q5 High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix, spell(NEB) M zero four nine two, fifty microlitre reaction, and it has seventeen steps. Say start when you're ready to begin.
Step one: assemble all reaction components on ice.
What step are we on?
We're on step one of seventeen: assemble all reaction components on ice.
I have done that, move on.
Step two: gently mix each component before adding it to the reaction.
Done, next one.
Step three: add twenty five microlitres of spell(Q) five High-Fidelity two spell(X) Master Mix to the reaction.
What temperature did you mention earlier?
I haven't mentioned any temperature yet — we're still on step three. Denaturation temperatures come up later, around step eleven.
How long is the annealing step?

name: look_up
arguments: {"query": "annealing step duration", "step_numbers": null, "status": "Checking the annealing step"}

text: The annealing step is ten to thirty seconds, at fifty to seventy two degrees celsius.
Go back to step two.
Step two: gently mix each component before adding it to the reaction.
Sorry, say that again?
Step two: gently mix each component before adding it to the reaction.
Take me to step nine.
Step nine: collect all liquid to the bottom of the tube with a quick centrifuge spin if necessary.
Set a timer for thirty seconds.

name: start_timer
arguments: {"seconds": 30, "label": "thirty second timer", "status": "Setting a thirty second timer"}

text: Timer set for thirty seconds.
What timers are running?
You've got the thirty second timer, with nineteen seconds left.
What pH should the buffer be?

instructions: The timer for thirty second timer has just finished. Tell them so, in one short sentence, and say nothing else. Do not read a step and do not ask a question.

name: look_up
arguments: {"query": "pH buffer", "step_numbers": null, "status": "Checking for buffer pH information"}

text: The protocol doesn't say anything about buffer pH.
Your thirty second timer is up.
